entries.text: Pinnock’s 1982 English Concert Brandenburgs remain the digital period-instrument classic for this set: animated, studio-clear, directed from the harpsichord. Against Harnoncourt’s 1964 pioneering tapes they are a generation later in technique; against Richter’s modern Munich cycle they restore natural brass and gut as audible stance. Later one-to-a-part HIP and Pinnock’s own Avie remake argue with these tapes — they do not retire them. Référence for the HIP studio side.

ledger.title: MusicWeb International — Laurson on Pinnock Avie / Archiv baseline
ledger.note: 1982 still ranked among top HIP choices; the baseline later HIP argues with.

ledger.title: MusicBrainz — Archiv 1982 Henry Wood Hall (Pinnock / English Concert)
ledger.note: Early digital Archiv studio — clear, present; brass/strings of their moment.

entries.text: Harnoncourt’s first Concentus Musicus cycle is the pioneering original-instrument document — Vienna 1964, Telefunken Das Alte Werk — not the 1981 remake and not the “1967” year that later label copy invents. Against Pinnock 1982 it is rougher and historically first; against Richter it is the opposite instrumentarium. Keep it for the argument’s opening statement, not as the smoothest HIP listen.

ledger.title: Bach Cantatas Website — Harnoncourt Brandenburg cycles
ledger.note: First complete CMW cycle; historical first statement of the HIP argument.

ledger.title: MusicBrainz — Telefunken/Teldec 1964 Palais Schönburg
ledger.note: 1964 OI capture — serviceable document; later DMM remake is smoother.

entries.text: Richter’s January 1967 Munich Archiv cycle is modern-instrument Bach freed from ponderous habit — concertino as soloists in ensemble, not yet HIP. Against Harnoncourt and Pinnock it is the other stance: steel strings and modern brass as a living orchestra. Voyager took the Second Concerto’s opening from these tapes; that is a fact of reception, not a magazine crown. The modern Munich pole of this argument.

ledger.title: MusicWeb International — McElhearn on Richter Brandenburg / Suites
ledger.note: Light, quick modern Munich style; concertino balance as historical place-holder.

ledger.title: NASA / Voyager Golden Record — Brandenburg 2 / Munich Bach Orchestra
ledger.note: 1967 Archiv capture clean enough for the Golden Record; solid mid-sixties stereo.
